nodes.name: FB Webhook (Inbound)
nodes.notes: Subscribe this URL in Meta Developer Console → Messenger → Webhooks. Verify token = MESSENGER_VERIFY_TOKEN env.

nodes.name: POST to Nexus Webhook
nodes.notes: NEXUS_WEBHOOK_URL = https://messenger.nexus.gayo-sphere.cloud  /  N8N_OUTBOUND_LISTENER_URL = this workflow's 'Outbound Listener' webhook URL.

nodes.name: Outbound Listener (from worker)
nodes.notes: Receives the worker's POST. Set MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL (or per-request outbound_url) to this webhook's URL.

_meta.description: Phase 8 bridge: Facebook → n8n (HMAC validated) → Nexus FastAPI (X-Webhook-Api-Key) → worker → n8n outbound → Facebook Send API.
